It peaked at number one in the UK Singles Chart for two weeks in May 1999 . It moved to 182,000 units in the first two weeks of its release and spent 13 weeks on the charts . This made it the first of fourteen UK number-one singles . To date , it is Westlife 's only single to have charted in the U.S. , peaking at number 20 on the Billboard Hot 100 and ranking number 75 on the Billboard Hot 100 Year End Charts , in 2000 . The song was performed live on Miss Teen USA 2000 . The single has sold over 600,000 copies to date in the UK and the US and also achieved gold status there .
